import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return p[0]+p[1]*L+p[2]/eps+p[3]*eps+(p[4]+p[5]*L+p[6]/eps+p[7]*eps)*np.exp(p[8]*T)+p[9]*T

L=np.log(eps); one=np.ones_like(eps)
def test(Elist,Tlist,label):
    cols=[e*t for e in Elist for t in Tlist]
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)
    print(label, A.shape[1], "%.3e"%(np.mean((sigma-A@c)**2)/np.var(sigma)))
